content: Civic/311-style reporting platforms (SeeClickFix, FixMyStreet-derived systems) commonly implement duplicate-report merging via geo-temporal clustering as a deduplication module distinct from the initial write path. DBSCAN is well suited (no fixed cluster count, arbitrary shapes, built-in outlier/noise detection) and is directly supported in PostGIS (ST_ClusterDBSCAN) for both ad hoc queries and materialized batch clustering. Running clustering synchronously on every single report write does not scale/is not idiomatic; the standard pattern is to persist the raw report immediately and run clustering as a triggered or scheduled background pass.
